name: org.machanism.machai:genai-client
description: GenAI Client is a Java 8 library that gives Machai applications a provider-neutral API for generative AI chat and embeddings. It resolves provider:model identifiers, manages prompts and instructions, supports OpenAI-compatible Responses and Embeddings APIs, Anthropic Claude Messages API, EPAM CodeMie OAuth delegation, local YAML-driven tool execution, and a no-op provider. It also provides annotation- and ServiceLoader-based Java function tools, prompts, resources, MCP servers, web search, working-directory context, configurable error handling, and per-model token-usage statistics. Use it for AI-enabled Java applications, semantic search, provider-independent chat workflows, function calling, and controlled local or remote tool integration.

usageContext: Integrate OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Claude, EPAM CodeMie, local tools, or disabled AI behavior behind org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.Genai.
Generate embedding vectors for semantic indexing, retrieval, and similarity search through org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.EmbeddingProvider.
Expose controlled Java methods as model-callable tools, reusable prompts, and URI-addressable resources using FunctionTools and runtime annotations.

constructors.description: Resolves, constructs, and initializes a Genai implementation from a Provider:Model identifier. Conventional names resolve under org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.impl, while a dotted provider segment is treated as a fully qualified class name.

examples.title: Install, configure, and run an OpenAI chat provider
steps: Add the Maven dependency to the application pom.xml.
Provide OPENAI_API_KEY and optional runtime settings through the application Configurator.
Resolve OpenAI:gpt-4o-mini, add a prompt, invoke perform, and clear the reusable provider session.
examples.snippet:
<dependency>
  <groupId>org.machanism.machai</groupId>
  <artifactId>genai-client</artifactId>
  <version>1.4.0</version>
</dependency>

OPENAI_API_KEY=your-secret
GENAI_TIMEOUT=60

org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.Genai provider = org.machanism.machai.ai.manager.GenaiProviderManager.getProvider("OpenAI:gpt-4o-mini", getApplicationConfigurator());
provider.prompt("Create a project summary.");
java.lang.String response = provider.perform();
provider.clear();
